article_notes: Onderstepoort retrospective analysis of two prospective B. rossi cohorts (96 dogs 2011-2013, the cytokine cohort of Goddard et al. 2016; 44 dogs 2014, lymphocyte-subset study); dogs overlap with those articles and probably with the CB040 pooled cohort. PCR/RLB confirmation, samples at presentation before treatment. Correlations of MPXI with cytokines within non-survivors and within survivors are not severity comparisons and were not extracted. Biochemistry and cytokine results by group are only in the Supplementary Material.

severity_definitions.label: non-survivors vs survivors
severity_definitions.definition: Short-term outcome: survival to discharge vs death or euthanasia due to poor prognosis during hospitalisation. 15/140 died.
severity_definitions.quote: Outcome was noted as short-term survival (i.e., until discharge from hospital), or death/euthanasia due to poor prognosis during hospitalization.
